Historical staging Rekor v1 interoperability fixture, extracted without changing
signed bytes from sigstore/sigstore-python at dbe933f28eb6433d0271ab96e0f1349dc0912c8f.
Source: test/assets/bundle.txt.sigstore
Key: test/assets/staging-tuf/targets/1d80b8f72505a43e65e6e125247cd508f61b459dc457c1d1bcb78d96e1760959.rekor.pub

Only the tlog entry is retained; certificate and artifact-signature appraisal
are not performed by these tests. Protobuf JSON integer strings and base64
proof hashes are converted to the equivalent Rekor v1 HTTP response types.
The staging key is explicit test trust, never the production default.
